title: Ignite: hosted API sample flow screenshots and annotated assets
creator: Marissa Chen
description:
Produce a compact suite of getting-started screenshots and annotated assets for the Hosted API onboarding flow. Deliverables should cover the model selector, request builder (form + advanced options), live streaming preview, and inlined SDK code snippets (JavaScript + Python) with copy buttons. Assets must include light and dark variants, a mobile/narrow layout set, and an accessibility-friendly overlay version (large type, clear contrast, ARIA annotations). Goal is to support the new quickstart in the Console guide + in-product tour and the docs quickstart page.

Constraints: keep asset bundle size reasonable (max 10 PNGs per variant), avoid using model names that imply paid tiers, and ensure code snippets are sync'd with runtime-1.22 API surface. Annotate each screenshot with short callouts (30-60 characters) for the docs team to reuse.

Primary stakeholders: PM (Elise Navarro), Docs (Ravi Singh), DevRel (Aisha Patel), Frontend (ENG-4321).
steps: Align requirements w/ PM and Docs — confirm exact SDK examples and API parameters
Create initial Figma frames for light/dark/narrow states
Iterate visuals with frontend devs for accurate UI chrome and copy
Export PNGs @2x (1280x720 for card use, 2560x1440 for hero use) and SVG callouts
Produce annotated overlay PNGs and a text-only accessibility specification
Handoff assets to Docs + Console with a short usage guide and alt text
acceptance_criteria: Seven screenshot compositions delivered: Model Picker, Request Builder (default), Request Builder (advanced options open), Streaming Preview (streaming ON), Code Snippet Expanded (JS), Code Snippet Expanded (Python), Error state with retry CTA
Light and dark mode variants for all compositions
Mobile (narrow) versions for the top three flows
Annotated overlays with concise callouts and exported SVG markers
All code snippets verify against runtime-1.22 API and pass a quick smoke test by DevRel
Alt text and copy-ready captions provided for each image
Assets uploaded to the shared Drive and Figma link updated in ticket
